text:
sam: seeing a weird convergence issue in staging-west2 — p95 remote_write latency jumped and prometheus is reporting a sudden series churn after the canary deploy
julia: saw that alert, digging into grafana now. is this the same relabel change from the canary? @lee did you roll the relabel regex last night?
lee: yup I pushed a small relabel to drop `pod_template_hash` but it was scoped to the sidecar exporter group only. I did not touch the gpu-exporter scrape job
maria: logs show exporter restarts around the same time. maybe metadata churn + relabel mismatch created duplicate series keys
devon: can you paste the prometheus scrape logs? also check remote_write 429/timeout counts on the proxy
sam: grabbing logs — snippet:

```
level=warn ts=2025-10-21T07:12:31Z caller=scrape.go:1235 component="scrape manager" job="gpu-exporter" msg="error fetching" err="read tcp 10.10.9.5:9090->10.10.9.14:32768: i/o timeout"
level=info ts=2025-10-21T07:12:32Z caller=push.go:210 component=remote_write msg="failed to send block" status=429 err="remote_write: rate limited"
```

julia: that timeout line + 429s aligns with remote_write backpressure. But the series spike looks like duplicated series after relabel failed on some targets
lee: my relabel regex used `replacement: "$1"` for `(?P<pod>[-a-z0-9]+)` — I might have inadvertently captured empty for some hostnames
maria: can we run `promtool tsdb analyze` on the staging data? also check `metric_relabel_configs` — we might need a temporary drop for high-card metrics
devon: quick mitigations:
- add a metric_relabel to drop labels we don't need (example: `metric_relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_pod_template_h]
    action: drop`)
- reduce scrape timeout to 8s for the noisy job
- enable `honor_labels: false` maybe to prevent label overwrites from exporters
sam: also thinking about receiver-side: pushgateway/proxy is seeing 429s. we can add a short circuit on the remote_write side: route staging-west2 to a lower-traffic replica or buffer with increased queue_capacity
julia: I'm worried about dropping labels blindly. Can we instead add a conditional relabel that drops when label value matches a transient pattern? e.g., `regex: ".*pod_template_hash.*"
action: replace` — but safer to `replace` with `""`? Not sure
lee: safer pattern I can push: `metric_relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [pod_template_hash]
  regex: ".+"
  action: replace
  replacement: ""
` That clears the label without deleting the metric
maria: also check exporter restarts cause series to re-register with different `instance` label — we should normalize `instance` to `pod_name:port` in relabeling
devon: for the remote_write backpressure, we should monitor `queue_capacity` and `max_samples_per_send`. Temporarily lower `max_samples_per_send` to avoid giant batches triggering timeouts
sam: who can rollout the safe relabel patch to staging? and can we add an alert to detect sudden unique series growth > 10% in 5m window
julia: I can apply the relabel patch in ~15 min and add the metric_relabel drop for `pod_template_hash`. I'll also create a short grafana panel to track "unique series delta" for that job
lee: after patch I'll watch prometheus logs and remote_write status. If 429s persist we fallback to routing staging-west2 to a spare remote_write endpoint
maria: notes for postmortem: consider adding a linter rule in CI that prevents relabels that might produce empty captures; and add a dry-run diff for relabel config using `promtool config check` + a simulated scrape
devon: created a quick receiver rule to route to spare replica: `kubectl patch svc remote-write --type=json -p='[ { "op": "replace", "path": "/spec/externalName", "value": "remote-write-spare.internal" } ]'`
sam: thanks. please post results here.
julia: patch applied: https://kube-console/argo/rollouts/rollout/sha/1234 — watching
scrape-bot: alert resolved: remote_write 429 rate if decreased to baseline (alert cleared at 1754450870)
sam: looking at grafana — series delta dropped back to normal, and remote_write latency p95 reduced. will keep under observation for 1h
lee: opened a PR with safer relabel + metric_relabel examples: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/712
maria: we'll follow up with a small runbook to handle exporter restarts causing label churn. draft in #eng-sre/wiki
devon: added short-term dashboard panels for queue_depth, send_samples, unique_series_delta for all remote_write shards
sam: great job team :thumbsup: we'll close the incident if nothing else pops in the next hour
